title: callitropsis × leylandii
intro: Callitropsis × leylandii, commonly known as Leyland cypress, is a fast-growing evergreen coniferous tree that is a hybrid of Cupressus macrocarpa and Callitropsis nootkatensis. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to help alleviate respiratory issues and act as an expectorant, relieving coughs and congestion. The therapeutic actions of Leyland cypress include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
